standard.coverage: All employers except the state, its political subdivisions, and small businesses grossing under $500,000 that are exempt from the FLSA.
standard.note: Annual CPI adjustment under the Fair Wages and Healthy Families Act (Prop 206, 2016).

tipped.note: A.R.S. 23-363(C) caps the tip credit at $3.00/hr flat -- a fixed DOLLAR credit, not a percentage, so it does not grow with the minimum wage.

indexation.basis: CPI-U (US city average), rounded to the nearest $0.05

knownGaps: Flagstaff and Tucson set higher local minimum wages -- see local/AZ-local-2026.json.
